Definition: a hook (the name of the sixth Hebrew letter)
BiblicalUsage: The veil was hung upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold, their hooks of gold, and the hanging of the door upon five pillars, their hooks of gold.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hooks matter because the holy things hung on them: gold hooks held the veil that hid the ark, and the smallest fittings of the tabernacle were made to carry glory.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
